comment: Scan of a 1980s E&MM magazine article. Page 1 (8b2012170321c44c.jpg) is text, a photo and the schematic; page 2 (7619c37d2581f452.jpg) has Figure 2, an etched PCB component overlay that prints DESIGNATORS ONLY (R1-R14, C1-C7, TR1-3, IC1, RV3, S1), no values on the parts. The values here are taken from the article's printed 'Parts list for Auto Swell' on page 3 (068966bcfb998d4d.jpg), matched to the overlay designators; all 14 resistors, 7 capacitors, 3 transistors, IC1, RV3 and S1 were found on the overlay. The other three pictures are thumbnails of the same pages.
uncertain: R8 at the bottom edge of the overlay is printed blurred and reads as 'R6' or 'R8'; taken as R8 because R6 is clearly printed at the top right
R11 at the left edge is printed split over two lines ('R' / '11') and is partly smudged
rows: push-to-make foot switch that starts the swell (effect control, not bypass)
